title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Find the length of the longest run of consecutive numbers in an unsorted array.

data.text: Given an unsorted array `nums`, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence.
Sort the array, then count consecutive runs. O(n log n) time, O(1) extra space.

data.title: Sort + Scan O(n log n)

data.text: Put all numbers in a set. For each number that is a sequence start (no predecessor), count forward. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: HashSet O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n log n) → O(n). **Space:** O(1) → O(n). Only counting from sequence starts avoids redundant work — each number is visited at most twice.

cards.title: HashSet
cards.description: Only start counting from sequence beginnings
